name: storm-arrive
title: Velia: the afternoon storm arrives
about: wow/storm, part 1 of the storm film (14 s): arc 40–180 s at 10×. Halcyon on a reach off Emerald Bay's mouth; the camera on her starboard side looks across her to the WSW: the cell rolls in over the western ridge, the rain's curtains and the shelf come down the bay, the rain arrives, three bolts on the ridges.
